instructionZh: 将金酒、金巴利与甜味美思按 1:1:1 倒入预冷搅拌杯。
instructionEn: Combine gin, Campari and sweet vermouth in a chilled mixing glass at 1:1:1.

instructionZh: 加入方冰与一颗大冰球至 2/3 满。
instructionEn: Fill the mixing glass two-thirds with cubed ice and one large mixing cube.

instructionZh: 用吧匙顺时针搅和约 30 圈，约 30 秒。
instructionEn: Stir smoothly with a bar spoon for about 30 rotations (~30 seconds).
tipZh: 搅和速度要稳，避免剧烈搅动引入过多气泡。
tipEn: Keep the motion smooth to avoid whipping air into the drink.

instructionZh: 用 Hawthorne 滤网滤入装有冰球的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Strain through a Hawthorne strainer into a rocks glass with a large ice cube.

instructionZh: 橙皮在酒面喷香后放入杯中。
instructionEn: Express orange peel oils over the surface and drop in.
tipZh: 白色海绵层尽量削薄，避免苦味。
tipEn: Trim the pith to avoid bitterness.

instructionZh: 在 rocks 杯中放入方糖。
instructionEn: Place a sugar cube in a rocks glass.

instructionZh: 滴 2 dashes 安格斯特拉苦精在方糖上。
instructionEn: Dash 2 dashes of Angostura onto the sugar cube.

instructionZh: 加少量苏打水，捣棒将方糖压至完全溶解。
instructionEn: Add a splash of soda and muddle the cube until fully dissolved.
tipZh: 用捣棒的钝端，仅靠自重压下即可。
tipEn: Use the flat end of the muddler with just its own weight.

instructionZh: 加入大冰球一颗。
instructionEn: Add one large ice cube.

instructionZh: 倒入波本威士忌。
instructionEn: Pour the bourbon over the ice.

instructionZh: 用吧匙搅和 10-15 秒让酒液降温。
instructionEn: Stir with a bar spoon for 10-15 seconds to chill.

instructionZh: 橙皮喷香，樱桃装饰（可选）。
instructionEn: Express orange peel; add a cherry (optional).

instructionZh: 马天尼杯口擦青柠汁，蘸细海盐（可选）。
instructionEn: Rim a coupe with salt using a lime wedge (optional).
tipZh: 留一段空边作为「观景窗」。
tipEn: Leave a clear band as a viewing window.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加龙舌兰、君度、青柠汁与龙舌兰糖浆。
instructionEn: Add tequila, Cointreau, lime juice and agave syrup to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10-12 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake hard for 10-12 seconds.
tipZh: 听冰块声音从清脆变低沉即可。
tipEn: Shake until the ice just stops cracking sharply.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into the chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加白朗姆、青柠汁与单糖浆。
instructionEn: Add white rum, lime juice and simple syrup to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 青柠皮在酒面喷香装饰。
instructionEn: Express lime peel oils over the surface.

instructionZh: 搅拌杯加黑麦、甜味美思与安格斯特拉。
instructionEn: Combine rye, sweet vermouth and Angostura in a mixing glass.

instructionZh: 加冰搅和 30 秒。
instructionEn: Add ice and stir for 30 seconds.

instructionZh: 滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 酒渍樱桃沉底，橙皮喷香装饰（可选）。
instructionEn: Drop in a brandied cherry; express orange peel (optional).

instructionZh: 搅拌杯加金酒与干味美思（比例可调）。
instructionEn: Combine gin and dry vermouth in a mixing glass (ratio to taste).

instructionZh: 加冰搅和 30 秒。
instructionEn: Add ice and stir for 30 seconds.
tipZh: 若要更 'dry'，可减半干味美思。
tipEn: For a drier martini, halve the vermouth.

instructionZh: 滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 柠檬皮喷香或放入橄榄装饰。
instructionEn: Express lemon peel or garnish with an olive.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加波本、柠檬汁、单糖浆与蛋清。
instructionEn: Add bourbon, lemon juice, simple syrup and egg white to a shaker (no ice).

instructionZh: 不加冰干摇 15 秒，让蛋清充分乳化。
instructionEn: Dry-shake hard for 15 seconds to emulsify the egg white.
tipZh: 干摇时间不足会导致泡沫稀薄。
tipEn: Under-shaking the dry phase leaves a thin foam.

instructionZh: 加冰再摇 10-12 秒。
instructionEn: Add ice and wet-shake for 10-12 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有冰球的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a rocks glass with a large ice cube.

instructionZh: 泡沫顶部点 3 滴安格斯特拉，樱桃装饰。
instructionEn: Float 3 drops Angostura on the foam; garnish with a cherry.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶底放入砂糖与薄荷叶。
instructionEn: Place sugar and mint leaves at the bottom of the shaker.

instructionZh: 用木质捣棒轻压 3-4 次释放薄荷油。
instructionEn: Gently muddle 3-4 times to release mint oils.
tipZh: 轻压——过狠会释放叶绿素导致发苦。
tipEn: Be gentle — over-muddling releases chlorophyll and bitterness.

instructionZh: 加入白朗姆与青柠汁，加冰摇和 8 秒。
instructionEn: Add white rum and lime juice; fill with ice and shake for 8 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有碎冰的高球杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a highball filled with crushed ice.

instructionZh: 顶部加苏打水，薄荷枝拍打后装饰。
instructionEn: Top with soda; slap a mint sprig and garnish.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加伏特加、君度、青柠汁与蔓越莓汁。
instructionEn: Add vodka, Cointreau, lime and cranberry juice to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10-12 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10-12 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 橙皮喷香或柠檬皮装饰。
instructionEn: Express orange or lemon peel over the surface.

instructionZh: 高球杯（或铜杯）装满方冰。
instructionEn: Fill a highball (or copper mug) with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 倒入伏特加与青柠汁。
instructionEn: Pour vodka and lime juice over the ice.

instructionZh: 加满冰镇姜汁啤酒。
instructionEn: Top with chilled ginger beer.
tipZh: 沿杯壁或吧匙倒入，保留气泡。
tipEn: Pour down the side to preserve carbonation.

instructionZh: 吧匙从下往上轻搅 2 次。
instructionEn: Stir once from bottom to top with a bar spoon.

instructionZh: 青柠角装饰杯口。
instructionEn: Garnish with a lime wedge.

instructionZh: 大红酒杯装满方冰。
instructionEn: Fill a large wine glass with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 先加入普罗赛克。
instructionEn: Add the prosecco first.

instructionZh: 再加入阿佩罗（顺序很重要）。
instructionEn: Add the Aperol next (order matters for colour).
tipZh: 按 3:2:1 比例普罗赛克:阿佩罗:苏打。
tipEn: 3:2:1 prosecco to Aperol to soda is classic.

instructionZh: 顶部加少量苏打水。
instructionEn: Top with a splash of soda water.

instructionZh: 橙片装饰杯口。
instructionEn: Garnish with an orange slice.

instructionZh: 搅拌杯加波本、金巴利与甜味美思。
instructionEn: Combine bourbon, Campari and sweet vermouth in a mixing glass.

instructionZh: 加冰搅和 30 秒。
instructionEn: Add ice and stir for 30 seconds.

instructionZh: 滤入装有冰球的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Strain into a rocks glass with a large ice cube.

instructionZh: 橙皮喷香装饰。
instructionEn: Express orange peel over the surface.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加调和威士忌、柠檬汁、蜂蜜糖浆与姜糖浆。
instructionEn: Add blended scotch, lemon juice, honey syrup and ginger syrup to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 12 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 12 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有冰球的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a rocks glass with a large ice cube.

instructionZh: 用吧匙背面将艾雷岛威士忌缓慢浮于酒面。
instructionEn: Float the Islay scotch on top using the back of a bar spoon.
tipZh: 缓慢倒入保持层次。
tipEn: Pour slowly to maintain the layer.

instructionZh: 肉桂枝装饰（可选）。
instructionEn: Garnish with a cinnamon stick (optional).

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加金酒、绿查特、马拉斯奇诺与青柠汁。
instructionEn: Add gin, green Chartreuse, maraschino and lime juice to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 酒渍樱桃装饰（可选）。
instructionEn: Garnish with a brandied cherry (optional).

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加波本、阿佩罗、杏仁酒与柠檬汁。
instructionEn: Add bourbon, Aperol, amaretto and lemon juice to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 搅拌杯加黑麦、干邑、甜味美思、本笃会酒、安格斯特拉与 Peychaud's。
instructionEn: Combine rye, cognac, sweet vermouth, Bénédictine, Angostura and Peychaud's in a mixing glass.

instructionZh: 加冰搅和 30 秒。
instructionEn: Add ice and stir for 30 seconds.

instructionZh: 滤入装有冰球的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Strain into a rocks glass with a large ice cube.

instructionZh: 柠檬皮或樱桃装饰。
instructionEn: Express lemon peel or garnish with a cherry.

instructionZh: 银杯或 julep 杯中放入薄荷与方糖。
instructionEn: Place mint sprigs and a sugar cube in a silver julep cup.

instructionZh: 轻捣 3 次释放薄荷油。
instructionEn: Gently muddle 3 times.
tipZh: 轻捣即可，过度捣压会破坏薄荷。
tipEn: Just bruise the mint, don't pulverise it.

instructionZh: 加入波本。
instructionEn: Pour in the bourbon.

instructionZh: 加碎冰至 3/4 满，搅匀。
instructionEn: Fill 3/4 with crushed ice and stir to combine.

instructionZh: 杯口堆起碎冰圆顶。
instructionEn: Top with more crushed ice to form a dome.

instructionZh: 薄荷枝装饰杯口。
instructionEn: Garnish with a fresh mint sprig.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加金酒、樱桃希林、本笃会酒、菠萝汁、青柠汁、石榴糖浆与安格斯特拉。
instructionEn: Add gin, Cherry Heering, Bénédictine, pineapple, lime, grenadine and Angostura to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 15 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 15 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有方冰的高球杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a highball with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 顶部加少量苏打水。
instructionEn: Top with a splash of soda.

instructionZh: 樱桃与菠萝片装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a cherry and a pineapple wedge.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加陈年朗姆 30ml、君度、杏仁糖浆与青柠汁。
instructionEn: Add 30ml aged rum, Cointreau, orgeat and lime juice to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有碎冰的 tiki 杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a tiki mug filled with crushed ice.

instructionZh: 将剩余 15ml 陈年朗姆缓慢浮于酒面。
instructionEn: Float the remaining 15ml aged rum on top using a bar spoon.

instructionZh: 薄荷枝与青柠皮装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a mint sprig and lime peel.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加皮斯科、青柠汁、单糖浆与蛋清。
instructionEn: Add pisco, lime juice, simple syrup and egg white to a shaker (no ice).

instructionZh: 不加冰干摇 15 秒。
instructionEn: Dry-shake hard for 15 seconds.
tipZh: 干摇时间不足会导致泡沫稀薄。
tipEn: Insufficient dry-shaking leaves a thin foam cap.

instructionZh: 加冰再摇 10-12 秒。
instructionEn: Add ice and shake for another 10-12 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 泡沫顶部点 3 滴安格斯特拉。
instructionEn: Drop 3 dashes of Angostura on the foam.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加伏特加、番茄汁、柠檬汁、伍斯特酱、盐与苦精。
instructionEn: Add vodka, tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, salt and bitters to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰轻滚 5-6 次（避免起泡）。
instructionEn: Add ice and roll 5-6 times to avoid foam.
tipZh: 滚和而非摇和——保持番茄汁顺滑口感。
tipEn: Rolling, not shaking, keeps the texture smooth.

instructionZh: 滤入装有方冰的高球杯。
instructionEn: Strain into a highball with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 芹菜杆与橄榄装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a celery stick and olives.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加金酒、柠檬汁与单糖浆。
instructionEn: Add gin, lemon juice and simple syrup to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入香槟杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a champagne flute.

instructionZh: 顶部加注冰镇干型香槟。
instructionEn: Top with chilled dry Champagne.
tipZh: 沿杯壁缓慢倒以保留气泡。
tipEn: Pour down the side to keep the fizz.

instructionZh: 柠檬皮装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a lemon twist.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加金酒、柠檬汁与单糖浆。
instructionEn: Add gin, lemon juice and simple syrup to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有方冰的高球杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a highball with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 顶部加苏打水。
instructionEn: Top with soda water.

instructionZh: 樱桃与橙片装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a cherry and an orange slice.

instructionZh: 高球杯装满方冰。
instructionEn: Fill a highball with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 倒入金酒。
instructionEn: Pour in the gin.

instructionZh: 加满冰镇汤力水。
instructionEn: Top with chilled tonic water.
tipZh: 沿杯壁缓慢倒入，保留气泡。
tipEn: Pour down the side to keep the bubbles.

instructionZh: 吧匙从下往上轻搅 1 次。
instructionEn: Stir once from bottom to top.

instructionZh: 青柠角或青柠片装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a lime wedge or wheel.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加金酒、柠檬汁与单糖浆。
instructionEn: Add gin, lemon juice and simple syrup to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有碎冰的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a rocks glass packed with crushed ice.

instructionZh: 将黑莓酒沿吧匙缓慢淋在碎冰上。
instructionEn: Drizzle the crème de mure over the crushed ice using a bar spoon.
tipZh: 缓慢淋面形成层叠效果。
tipEn: Drizzle slowly for a layered look.

instructionZh: 薄荷枝与柠檬片装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a mint sprig and lemon slice.

instructionZh: 高球杯装满方冰。
instructionEn: Fill a highball with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 加入青柠汁。
instructionEn: Add the lime juice.

instructionZh: 加满冰镇姜汁啤酒。
instructionEn: Top with chilled ginger beer.

instructionZh: 黑朗姆沿吧匙背面缓慢浮于酒面（云层效果）。
instructionEn: Float the dark rum on top using the back of a bar spoon.
tipZh: 慢慢倒形成云层效果——这是配方的标志。
tipEn: Slow pour creates the signature 'stormy' cloud.

instructionZh: 青柠角装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a lime wedge.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加伏特加、咖啡酒、现磨浓缩咖啡与单糖浆。
instructionEn: Add vodka, Kahlúa, freshly pulled espresso and simple syrup to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰用力摇和 15 秒至壶身结霜。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake very hard for 15 seconds until frosted.
tipZh: 用力摇——这是形成绵密泡沫的关键。
tipEn: Shake hard — this is what creates the signature crema.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 3 颗咖啡豆装饰（健康、财富、幸福）。
instructionEn: Float 3 coffee beans on the crema.

instructionZh: 高球杯杯口擦青柠汁，可选蘸盐。
instructionEn: Rim a highball with salt using a lime wedge (optional).

instructionZh: 杯中装满方冰。
instructionEn: Fill with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 加入龙舌兰与青柠汁。
instructionEn: Pour in the tequila and lime juice.

instructionZh: 加满西柚汽水（或西柚汁 + 苏打）。
instructionEn: Top with grapefruit soda (or fresh grapefruit + soda).
tipZh: 传统用 Squirt 或 Jarritos 西柚汽水。
tipEn: Tradition calls for Squirt or Jarritos grapefruit soda.

instructionEn: Give one gentle stir; garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

instructionEn: Dry-shake hard for 15 seconds.

instructionEn: Add ice and shake another 10-12 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入装有冰球的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a rocks glass with a large ice cube.

instructionZh: 樱桃与橙皮装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a cherry and an orange twist.

instructionEn: Combine scotch and Drambuie in a mixing glass.

instructionZh: 加冰搅和 20 秒。
instructionEn: Add ice and stir for 20 seconds.

instructionZh: 滤入装有方冰的 rocks 杯。
instructionEn: Strain into a rocks glass with cubed ice.

instructionZh: 柠檬皮装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a lemon twist.

instructionEn: Add gin, maraschino, crème de violette and lemon juice to a shaker.

instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10-12 seconds.

instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 樱桃装饰。
instructionEn: Garnish with a brandied cherry.

instructionZh: 马天尼杯内加 1 dash 苦艾酒轻转洗杯，倒掉多余。
instructionEn: Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe; discard the excess.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加金酒、丽蕾白、君度与柠檬汁。
instructionEn: Add gin, Lillet Blanc, Cointreau and lemon juice to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入洗过的马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into the rinsed coupe.

instructionZh: 橙皮或柠檬皮喷香装饰。
instructionEn: Express orange or lemon peel over the surface.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加白朗姆、西柚汁、青柠汁与马拉斯奇诺。
instructionEn: Add white rum, grapefruit juice, lime juice and maraschino to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionZh: 西柚皮喷香装饰。
instructionEn: Express grapefruit peel over the surface.

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加苹果白兰地、柠檬汁与石榴糖浆。
instructionEn: Add applejack, lemon juice and grenadine to a shaker.

instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 12 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

instructionEn: Garnish with a lemon twist (optional).

instructionZh: 摇酒壶加金酒、蜂蜜糖浆与柠檬汁。
instructionEn: Add gin, honey syrup and lemon juice to a shaker.

instructionZh: 加冰摇和 10-12 秒。
instructionEn: Fill with ice and shake for 10-12 seconds.

instructionZh: 双重过滤入预冷马天尼杯。
instructionEn: Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
